description: User-reported active nuget.org Trusted Publishing policy; this file records settings and does not register or activate the policy.
scope: Push new packages and package versions
workflowRequirements: Use the NuGet profile username of the policy creator when requesting a temporary API key; the package owner can differ.
Grant id-token: write to the publishing job defined directly in the Parties release.yml workflow.
Run authentication in the Parties job so NuGet sees the registered repository workflow identity; use the shared Builds prepare-domain-release composite for preparation.
Exchange a GitHub OIDC token with audience https://www.nuget.org for a temporary key shortly before publication.
Supply that temporary key to the existing NuGet push command instead of the long-lived NUGET_API_KEY secret.
Preserve the production environment and exact main-source release gates.
